S.FORM: ʔuuna kin-turaŋ-a sua iisua ia, ʔakia cina-ini mata cuum-ini.
S.PHON: ʔuuna kinturaŋa sua iisua ia ʔakia tʂinaini mata ʦuumini
S.FORM: 'uuna kinturanga sua iisua ia, 'akia cinaini mata cuumini.
S.PHON: ʔuuna kintu[r|ɾ]aŋa sua iisua ia ʔakia tʂinaini mata ʦuumini
S.TRANSL: There were two brothers, who had no father or mother.

S.FORM: si nanala ia, m-ala-cucua mu-kusa rəmər-a c<um>a-cipi.
S.PHON: ʂi nanaɾa ia maɾaʦuʦua mukusa rəməra ʦumatʂipi
S.FORM: si nanara ia, maracucua mukusa remera c<um>acipi.
S.PHON: ʂi nana[r|ɾ]a ia ma[r|ɾ]aʦuʦua mukusa [r|ɾ]eme[r|ɾ]a ʦumatʂipi
S.TRANSL: Because they were orphans, they went to a bush to set up a bird trap.

S.FORM: maka-anə ʔinia s<əm>ərəcə ia, ni-mu-cipi u-cani tavənəvənə.
S.PHON: makaanə ʔinia səmərəʦə ia nimutʂipi uʦani tavənəvənə
S.FORM: makaane 'inia s<em>erece ia, nimucipi ucani tavenevene.
S.PHON: makaane ʔinia seme[r|ɾ]eʦe ia nimutʂipi uʦani tavenevene
S.TRANSL: The first time they went to check it, it caught a banana.

S.FORM: ala ʔinia sua tavənəvənə, sua kuic-ini ia, ni-kaən kanaʔua-ini; sua kanarua ia, ni-kaən=kiai sua vura-ini.
S.PHON: aɾa ʔinia sua tavənəvənə sua kuitʂini ia nikaən kanaʔuaini sua kanarua ia nikaənkiai sua vuraini
S.FORM: ara 'inia sua tavenevene, sua kuicini ia, nikaen kana'uaini; sua kanarua ia, nikaenkiai sua vuraini.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]a ʔinia sua tavenevene sua kuitʂini ia nikaen kanaʔuaini sua kana[r|ɾ]ua ia nikaenkiai sua vu[r|ɾ]aini
S.TRANSL: They took the banana; the elder brother ate the peel while the younger brother ate the fruit.

S.FORM: masua=cu mipi-ta-pusa-n=ci s<əm>ərəcə ia, u-rucini=cu macuʔa sua tavənəvənə.
S.PHON: masuaʦu mipitapusantʂi səmərəʦə ia urutʂiniʦu maʦuʔa sua tavənəvənə
S.FORM: masuacu mipitapusanci s<em>erece ia, urucinicu macu'a sua tavenevene.
S.PHON: masuaʦu mipitapusantʂi seme[r|ɾ]eʦe ia u[r|ɾ]utʂiniʦu maʦuʔa sua tavenevene
S.TRANSL: The second time they went to check it, there were two bananas.

S.FORM: makasua=cu maa-cani kanaʔua mata kanarua-ini.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu maaʦani kanaʔua mata kanaruaini
S.FORM: makasuacu maacani kana'ua mata kanaruaini.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu maaʦani kanaʔua mata kana[r|ɾ]uaini
S.TRANSL: The elder and younger brothers each had one (banana).

S.FORM: makasua=cu mipi-ta-tulu-n ʔinia s<əm>ərəcə ia, u-cani=cu auaŋa sua tavənəvənə.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mipitatuɾun ʔinia səmərəʦə ia uʦaniʦu auaŋa sua tavənəvənə
S.FORM: makasuacu mipitaturun 'inia s<em>erece ia, ucanicu auanga sua tavenevene.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mipitatu[r|ɾ]un ʔinia seme[r|ɾ]eʦe ia uʦaniʦu auaŋa sua tavenevene
S.TRANSL: The third time they went to check it, there was a string of bananas.

S.FORM: ma-vəcərəkə=cu mii k<um>aən-ni si i-tumulu=cu.
S.PHON: mavəʦərəkəʦu mii kumaənni ʂi itumuɾuʦu
S.FORM: mavecerekecu mii k<um>aenni si itumurucu.
S.PHON: maveʦe[r|ɾ]ekeʦu mii kumaenni ʂi itumu[r|ɾ]uʦu
S.TRANSL: They were already full because they ate a lot.

S.FORM: makasua=cu mii maka-sipat-ən s<əm>ərəcə ia, ni-mu-cipi sua vənəvənə.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mii makaʂipatən səmərəʦə ia nimutʂipi sua vənəvənə
S.FORM: makasuacu mii makasipaten s<em>erece ia, nimucipi sua venevene.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu mii makaʂipaten seme[r|ɾ]eʦe ia nimutʂipi sua venevene
S.TRANSL: The fourth time they went to check it, a bird was trapped.

S.FORM: ala ʔinia sua vənəvənə isua ia, tapianaŋai, ala ʔinia mia-salai na salai-ini mu-caa ma-avici taanaasa.
S.PHON: aɾa ʔinia sua vənəvənə isua ia tapianaŋai aɾa ʔinia miasaɾai na saɾaiini muʦaa maavitʂi taanaasa
S.FORM: ara 'inia sua venevene isua ia, tapianangai, ara 'inia miasarai na saraiini mucaa maavici taanaasa.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]a ʔinia sua venevene isua ia tapianaŋai a[r|ɾ]a ʔinia miasa[r|ɾ]ai na sa[r|ɾ]aiini muʦaa maavitʂi taanaasa
S.TRANSL: They took the white-tailed blue robin, which is a type of bird, and they put it into their pocket and brought it home.

S.FORM: m-avici taanaasa. mia ma-ka-cəkəna-ini taanaasa ia, ni-ala=kiai m-ari-pa-piniŋ sua vənəvənə, ku-ala-tumulu na salai-ini sua pusiamə.
S.PHON: mavitʂi taanaasa mia makaʦəkənaini taanaasa ia niaɾakiai maripapiniŋ sua vənəvənə kuaɾatumuɾu na saɾaiini sua puʂiamə
S.FORM: mavici taanaasa. mia makacekenaini taanaasa ia, niarakiai maripapining sua venevene, kuaratumuru na saraiini sua pusiame.
S.PHON: mavitʂi taanaasa mia makaʦekenaini taanaasa ia nia[r|ɾ]akiai ma[r|ɾ]ipapiniŋ sua venevene kua[r|ɾ]atumu[r|ɾ]u na sa[r|ɾ]aiini sua puʂiame
S.TRANSL: They brought it home, arrived home, took the bird out, and their pocket was full of rice.

S.FORM: maa-kari=cu kin-turaŋ-a makasua ʔinia, "tia=kita kaa-manəŋə liuŋu tatia, pita-sikarə ʔinia sua vənəvənə."
S.PHON: maakariʦu kinturaŋa makasua ʔinia tiakita kaamanəŋə ɾiuŋu tatia pitaʂikarə ʔinia sua vənəvənə
S.FORM: maakaricu kinturanga makasua 'inia, "tiakita kaamanenge riungu tatia, pitasikare 'inia sua venevene."
S.PHON: maaka[r|ɾ]iʦu kintu[r|ɾ]aŋa makasua ʔinia tiakita kaamaneŋe [r|ɾ]iuŋu tatia pitaʂika[r|ɾ]e ʔinia sua venevene
S.TRANSL: The brothers discussed this, "Let's make a big granary, and put in the bird."

S.FORM: ni-ka-manəŋ=kiai sua liuŋu, makasua=cu ari-pa-piniŋ-ai ʔinia sua tapianaŋai, ku-ala-tumulu=cu sua ni-ka-manəŋ=kiai liuŋu.
S.PHON: nikamanəŋkiai sua ɾiuŋu makasuaʦu aripapiniŋai ʔinia sua tapianaŋai kuaɾatumuɾuʦu sua nikamanəŋkiai ɾiuŋu
S.FORM: nikamanengkiai sua riungu, makasuacu aripapiningai 'inia sua tapianangai, kuaratumurucu sua nikamanengkiai riungu.
S.PHON: nikamaneŋkiai sua [r|ɾ]iuŋu makasuaʦu a[r|ɾ]ipapiniŋai ʔinia sua tapianaŋai kua[r|ɾ]atumu[r|ɾ]uʦu sua nikamaneŋkiai [r|ɾ]iuŋu
S.TRANSL: Then they made a granary, took out the bird, and the granary they made was full of rice.

S.FORM: makasua=cu ala ʔinia sua tapianaŋai pasa-vali na taarəkəra.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu aɾa ʔinia sua tapianaŋai pasavaɾi na taarəkəra
S.FORM: makasuacu ara 'inia sua tapianangai pasavari na taarekera.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu a[r|ɾ]a ʔinia sua tapianaŋai pasava[r|ɾ]i na taa[r|ɾ]eke[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: They took the bird out and put it into a mortar.

S.FORM: rəkəpai=kani ʔinia na taarəkəra.
S.PHON: rəkəpaikani ʔinia na taarəkəra
S.FORM: rekepaikani 'inia na taarekera.
S.PHON: [r|ɾ]ekepaikani ʔinia na taa[r|ɾ]eke[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: They closed it in a mortar.

S.FORM: cəʔəra-ən=kani=kiai sua taarəkəra, ku-ala-tumulu=cu pusiamə.
S.PHON: ʦəʔəraənkanikiai sua taarəkəra kuaɾatumuɾuʦu puʂiamə
S.FORM: ce'eraenkanikiai sua taarekera, kuaratumurucu pusiame.
S.PHON: ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aenkanikiai sua taa[r|ɾ]eke[r|ɾ]a kua[r|ɾ]atumu[r|ɾ]uʦu puʂiame
S.TRANSL: They looked at the mortar, and it was full of rice.

S.FORM: ala-i=kani ʔinia pasa-vali na tauamarə sua tapianaŋai ʔisua ia, ʔaisi=pa t<in>upuru na tauamarə, sua tauamarə ia, ku-ala-tumulu=cu pusiamə.
S.PHON: aɾaikani ʔinia pasavaɾi na tauamarə sua tapianaŋai ʔisua ia ʔaiʂipa tinupuru na tauamarə sua tauamarə ia kuaɾatumuɾuʦu puʂiamə
S.FORM: araikani 'inia pasavari na tauamare sua tapianangai 'isua ia, 'aisipa t<in>upuru na tauamare, sua tauamare ia, kuaratumurucu pusiame.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aikani ʔinia pasava[r|ɾ]i na tauama[r|ɾ]e sua tapianaŋai ʔisua ia ʔaiʂipa tinupu[r|ɾ]u na tauama[r|ɾ]e sua tauama[r|ɾ]e ia kua[r|ɾ]atumu[r|ɾ]uʦu puʂiame
S.TRANSL: They put the bird into a winnowing basket, and when it was still sitting in the winnowing basket, it was full of rice.

S.FORM: i-vatu sua cau ma-naasə sua isua ia, cau kalanana "a-pa-suluvai=pa=ku tapianaŋai=musu si ʔakia=cu kaən-a=maku. nuu ku-ala-tumulu=cu sua liuŋ=aku ia, a-pu-aiʔ-in=aku kasua," misa.
S.PHON: ivatu sua ʦau manaasə sua isua ia ʦau kaɾanana apasuɾuvaipaku tapianaŋaimusu ʂi ʔakiaʦu kaənamaku nuu kuaɾatumuɾuʦu sua ɾiuŋaku ia apuaiʔinaku kasua misa
S.FORM: ivatu sua cau manaase sua isua ia, cau karanana "apasuruvaipaku tapianangaimusu si 'akiacu kaenamaku. nuu kuaratumurucu sua riungaku ia, apuai'inaku kasua," misa.
S.PHON: ivatu sua ʦau manaase sua isua ia ʦau ka[r|ɾ]anana apasu[r|ɾ]uvaipaku tapianaŋaimusu ʂi ʔakiaʦu kaenamaku nuu kua[r|ɾ]atumu[r|ɾ]uʦu sua [r|ɾ]iuŋaku ia apuaiʔinaku kasua misa
S.TRANSL: Another person came and said to them, "Lend me your bird because I have no food. If my granary is full (of rice), I'll return it to you."

S.FORM: makasua=cu a-pa-suluvai=kiai ʔinia sua tapianaŋai.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu apasuɾuvaikiai ʔinia sua tapianaŋai
S.FORM: makasuacu apasuruvaikiai 'inia sua tapianangai.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu apasu[r|ɾ]uvaikiai ʔinia sua tapianaŋai
S.TRANSL: They lent him the bird.

S.FORM: s<in>uluvai=kiai, ʔakia=cu sua pusiamə.
S.PHON: ʂinuɾuvaikiai ʔakiaʦu sua puʂiamə
S.FORM: s<in>uruvaikiai, 'akiacu sua pusiame.
S.PHON: ʂinu[r|ɾ]uvaikiai ʔakiaʦu sua puʂiame
S.TRANSL: They lent it to him, yet there was no rice.

S.FORM: mia s<um>uluvai ʔinia. ʔapacuʔ-ai-ni patu-kusa-ən=kiai na tarəkəra ia, ma-vərəka, ʔakia=kani sua pusiamə.
S.PHON: mia sumuɾuvai ʔinia ʔapaʦuʔaini patukusaənkiai na tarəkəra ia mavərəka ʔakiakani sua puʂiamə
S.FORM: mia s<um>uruvai 'inia. 'apacu'aini patukusaenkiai na tarekera ia, mavereka, 'akiakani sua pusiame.
S.PHON: mia sumu[r|ɾ]uvai ʔinia ʔapaʦuʔaini patukusaenkiai na ta[r|ɾ]eke[r|ɾ]a ia mave[r|ɾ]eka ʔakiakani sua puʂiame
S.TRANSL: Then they lent it to him. Although he put it into a mortar and covered it, there was no rice.

S.FORM: ala ʔinia tapianaŋai m-ia-pacai.
S.PHON: aɾa ʔinia tapianaŋai miapaʦai
S.FORM: ara 'inia tapianangai miapacai.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]a ʔinia tapianaŋai miapaʦai
S.TRANSL: Then he killed the bird.

S.FORM: makasua=cu maamia ara-nupunupu sua tapianaŋai.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu maamia aranupunupu sua tapianaŋai
S.FORM: makasuacu maamia aranupunupu sua tapianangai.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu maamia a[r|ɾ]anupunupu sua tapianaŋai
S.TRANSL: In that way the bird disappeared.
